statement: In all Python files, Black formatting is applied with string normalization disabled, so existing quote styles must not be rewritten by the formatter.

quote: `setup.cfg` configures `flake8` with a max line length of 120 and ignores `E203`, `W503`, `SIM104`, `SIM105`, `SIM115`, and `I`.
statement: In platypush/** and tests/** Python files, lines must not exceed 120 characters; flake8 codes E203, W503, SIM104, SIM105, SIM115 and the I family are not enforced.

quote: The code should ideally have no LINT warnings/issues.
statement: In all source files, code should produce no lint (flake8 / eslint) warnings or issues.
In all Python files, code must be indented with 4 spaces.

quote: RST format for classes and methods documentation
statement: In platypush/** Python files, class and method docstrings must be written in reStructuredText (RST) format (e.g. :param x:, :return:, :type:).

quote: Naming conventions: plugin classes are named `<Module>Plugin` ... with `<Module>` being the (camel-case) representation of the Python module of the plugin without the prefix - for example, the plugin under `platypush.plugins.light.hue` must be named `LightHuePlugin`.
statement: In platypush/plugins/**, a plugin class must be named <Module>Plugin, where <Module> is the CamelCase form of its module path under platypush.plugins (e.g. platypush.plugins.light.hue -> LightHuePlugin).

quote: backend classes are named `<Module>Backend`, with `<Module>` being the (camel-case) representation of the Python module of the plugin without the prefix
statement: In platypush/backend/**, a backend class must be named <Module>Backend, where <Module> is the CamelCase form of its module path under platypush.backend (e.g. platypush.backend.http -> HttpBackend).

quote: if you are changing some of the core entities (e.g. requests, events, procedures, hooks, crons or the bus) then make sure to add tests and not to break the existing tests.
statement: Changes to core entities (requests, events, procedures, hooks, crons, the bus) must be accompanied by tests under tests/; new functionality should add a test where possible.
scope: platypush/message/**, platypush/procedure/**, platypush/event/**, platypush/cron/**, platypush/bus/** core modules

quote: If the feature requires an optional dependency then make sure to document it in the `manifest.json`
statement: In platypush/plugins/** and platypush/backend/**, every optional dependency an extension requires must be declared in that extension's manifest.json.
In all Python files checked by flake8, lines must not exceed 120 characters (E501).
flake8 rules are not applied to files named fliclib.py.
In all Python files, flake8 E203 (whitespace before ':') is not enforced.
In all Python files, flake8 W503 (line break before binary operator) is not enforced.
In all Python files, flake8-simplify SIM104 (use 'yield from' instead of a for loop yielding each item) is not enforced.
In all Python files, flake8-simplify SIM105 (use contextlib.suppress instead of try/except/pass) is not enforced.
In all Python files, flake8-simplify SIM115 (use a context manager for opening files) is not enforced.
In all Python files, flake8 I-family (import ordering) checks are not enforced.
In all Python files, flake8-bugbear (B) checks are enforced: code must not contain likely bugs such as mutable default arguments, bare except, or assert False.
In all Python files, flake8-comprehensions (C4) checks are enforced: code must not use unnecessary list/set/dict calls or comprehensions where a literal or simpler comprehension applies.
In all Python files, flake8-simplify (SIM) checks are enforced (except SIM104, SIM105, SIM115): code must not use constructs that have a simpler equivalent.
In platypush/backend/http/webapp/src/**, Vue component names are not required to be multi-word.
In platypush/backend/http/webapp/src/**, Vue components are allowed to use names reserved by HTML/Vue built-in elements.
